elbow_flex.source: ACE Seated Shoulder Press: press up until the elbows are fully extended but not locked (15 degrees); lower until the elbows are about level with the shoulders (illustrative 90 degrees), giving the delts a full stretch without over-stressing the joint

torso_lean.source: ACE Seated Shoulder Press: keep the head aligned with the spine and avoid arching the low back

muscles.peakSource: ACE Seated Shoulder Press: continue the press until fully extended but not locked, so delt effort is highest approaching that near-top position

mistake.name: Arch and lock

tells.text: The low back arches to help drive the press up.
The elbows slam to a hard lockout at the top.

mistake.source: ACE Seated Shoulder Press: avoid arching the low back during the press; press until fully extended but not locked, since locking out loses control and joint protection

sources: Contact fact (seat height, unverified_on_machine): ACE / Apex Personal Fitness — set the seat so the elbows begin just below shoulder level and the handles line up with the shoulders; a real-world description, not this app's numeric `seat` setting, so it is not written into `machine.settings` here
